title: Waiting Animation
desc: Whether to display a waiting animation while data is being retrieved from the main process

title: Waiting Animation Style
desc: Pick the animation style to use. Note 'Custom' requires you create a file named edcopilot-waiting-Custom.gif in the EDCoPilot folder.  'Random' will pick between Pulse, Spin and Custom

title: Windows Title Bar
desc: Add / remove the title bar

title: Always On Top
desc: Whether window will remain over other app windows

title: Apply 'Always On Top' when showing screen via hotkey
desc: If you use the hotkey to toggle the UI on/off the screen, set this ON if you want On Top to also be set when UI is shown

title: Transparency
desc: Set level of transparency from 100 (semi-invisible) to 255 (opaque)

title: Refocus Elite on every button click
desc: Immediately focus back on Elite after a button is clicked. Handy for overlay apps like Desktop+

title: Refocus Elite on every scroll
desc: Immediately focus back on Elite after a screen is scrolled.

title: Auto focus UI on hover
desc: Puts focus on the UI when you mouse over it. Note: this will move focus off of Elite Dangerous whenever you move the mouse over the panel. Do not use if you want to refocus Elite on every click

title: Number of UI instances to start
desc: Number of UI instances you would like started when you launch EDCoPilot (1 to 4)

title: Save default UI position and size
desc: Toggle this to ON to save the current UI position and size as its new default

title: Keyboard Type
desc: Pick between US (QWERTY), FR (AZERTY) or DE. NOTE: Restart EDCoPilot if you change this value to pick up new mappings

title: Hot Key Checking
desc: If ON, will check for hot keys being pressed

title: Hot Keys - Using EXTERNAL PROGRAM AutoHotkey - *NOTE* requires you install AutoHotkey separately
Use AutoHotkey
desc: If ON, will create and run an AutoHotkey script to handle EDCoPilot hotkey presses. Turn 'Hot Key Checking' above to OFF if you switch this one ON, else hot keys will fire twice!

title: Automatically close AutoHotkey
desc: If ON, will termminate AutoHotkey when EDCoPilot closes, or when the Use AutoHotkey option is disable

title: Clickable column title color
desc: If ON, will show the column name in a different color than rest of column names, for columns that have clickable fields

title: Show system population on Bookmarks panel
desc: If ON, will show the population of the system in the System Features column in Bookmarks

title: Check if route systems in EDSM
desc: If ON, will check systems in route to see if known to EDSM. Useful if in remote locations. Keep OFF to avoid unnecessary EDSM calls when not needed

title: Lock display (disables automatic panel swapping)
desc: If ON, this will stop ALL of the display options below from automatically switching to different panels when events happen in game.

title: Action to take on starting system jump
desc: What action to take when you initiate a system jump

title: Action to take on system arrival
desc: What action to take when you jump into a system

title: Auto-display body information on approach
desc: If on, will display the Body Information panel when you approach the body

title: Auto-display Controls panels
desc: If on, will display the Combat Controls panel when you deploy your hardpoints, Flight Controls when you retract, SRV controls when you board SRV, OnFoot controls when you go On Foot

title: Auto-display System Commands panel when manually plotting in game
desc: If on, will display the System Commands panel for the selected system when you set as target in either your Galaxy Map or Navigation panel

title: Auto-display Colonisation Progress when viewing Commodities Market
desc: If on, will display the Colonisation Progress panel when you open a station's Commodity Market menu
